messages:
Mariya: heads up — small-batch bringup of quant4b on long-code prompts is showing odd hallucinations on identifier names. example: returned function with invented helper 'sanitize_uuid42'.
Samir: ugh. is that from quant or promptset changes?
Mariya: looks like both. quant run drops logits on rare tokens, and our prompt dedupe pass accidentally kept several near-duplicates with slightly different suffixes, which boosted a bad pattern.
Jonah: can you paste the failing example?
Mariya: here — reproducer: ```python
curl -s -X POST https://redwood/api/v1/generate -d '{"model":"quant4b-v1","prompt":"// parse user id
function parse(id){ return id.split('-').map(...)","max_tokens":120}'
```
Mariya: output snippet: "function parse(id){ if (!is_valid(id)) return sanitize_uuid42(id); }" — sanitize_uuid42 is not in any training data.
Kei: reaction: :thinking_face: Quant-induced spurious tokens are known when we do aggressive per-channel quantization. Do we have kernel-level clamps on weird logits?
Samir: not currently. we have an open ticket to add fallback top-k smoothing for 4-bit variants but not rolled.
Mariya: immediate ask: pause rollout of quant4b to dedicated pools and run targeted evals vs our golden holdout of long-code prompts. need counts of duplicates in the prompt bank for that cohort.
labeling-bot: queued 72 samples for manual review from cohort "long-code/identifiers". link: https://internal/labeler/queue/3421
Jonah: i'll pull dedupe stats. quick check shows ~9% near-duplicate rate in that cohort (Levenshtein < 6).
Kei: proposal: 1) revert rollout for live traffic, 2) run quant run with top-k smoothing patch, 3) re-run eval on golden set + expanded semi-golden (add 500 adversarial variants), 4) purge duplicates >0.9 similarity from prompt bank and re-sample.
Samir: agree. also add a short-term mitigation in runtime to fallback to fp16 for tokens after seeing 3 OOVs in a window of 20 tokens. cheaper than full revert.
Mariya: prioritize: revert rollout now -> re-eval on golden (baseline vs quant4b+patch) -> labeler reviews flagged samples for hallucination taxonomy -> want results in 48h.
eng-oncall: reverted quant4b tag from prod pools @ 2765432145. monitoring and alerting set to watch hallucination metric.
Jonah: started dedupe job and sampling patch. will post stats when done. ETA ~2h.
Kei: I'll draft a short postmortem note and mitigation playbook for future model onboards (include dedupe gate, small-sweep quant smoke with long-code corpus).
Mariya: thanks team. small checklist before closing: add unit test for token-level spike guard, add a holdout specifically for code-identifiers, and bump labeling capacity for 48h.
Samir: noted. I'll assign follow-ups in the model-onboard project. :thumbsup:
